prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [home, new_screen] Desktop Hatching Live Preview Waiting Flow: Inserts a live hatching preview screen prior to rendering completion so users can monitor pet synthesis in real time.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "hint": "Your pet is currently being synthesized and prepared for your desktop display."}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "new_hatching_preview", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
1: [sign_in, hint] Account Pet Cloud Backup Security Hint: Adds a hint on the sign-in screen explaining that signing in links your pet companion to cloud backup for session persistence.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in anchors your pet to your account cloud backup so your desktop companion is never lost."}}
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Hatching Live Activity Log Display: Displays real-time technical milestones and rendering activity status text during pet generation.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "components": [{"type": "text", "text": "Status: Synthesizing pet desktop animations and behavioral routines...", "style": "subtle"}]}}
3: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Control Overview Finish Flow: Replaces the finish screen layout with an interactive checklist guiding users through basic pet desktop shortcuts and hide controls.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your Companion is Ready on Desktop!", "body": "Learn the essential shortcuts: right-click your pet for controls, drag to move, and double-click to chat.", "layout": "checklist", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "label": "Quick Desktop Shortcuts Guide"}]}}
4: [adoption, layout] Adoption Certificate Split Verification Layout: Reorganizes the adoption certificate step into a split column layout separating pet details from confirmation buttons.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Official Desktop Pet Adoption Certificate", "body": "Confirm your pet companion details to proceed to activation."}}
5: [finish, redesign] Finish Step Companion Desktop Quickstart Redesign: Redesigns the final intro screen into a stage layout with pet preview showcase and active launch trigger.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Welcome Your Desktop Pet", "body": "Your pet is now active on your desktop screen. Click below to complete setup and start interacting.", "components": [{"type": "preview", "asset": "asset:pet_preview_active", "style": "large"}, {"type": "button", "label": "Launch Desktop Pet", "action": "next", "style": "playful"}]}}
6: [choose_path, hint] Path Selection Account Persistence Safety Hint: Adds a hint clarifying that both pet selection paths (preset or custom) automatically sync with your signed-in account.
   config: {"choose_path": {"hint": "You can customize or select a preset pet companion; both sync automatically to your account."}}
7: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Personality Persona Confirmation Screen: Adds a dedicated persona confirmation screen before adoption certificate to preview pet behavioral tendencies.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"show_step_counter": true}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_persona_confirm", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
8: [sign_in, notification] Sign-In Session Restoration Alert Switch: Enables an explicit session restoration notification switch on the sign-in screen to confirm pet data protection.
   config: {"sign_in": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "We will restore your previous pet setup automatically once signed in."}}
9: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Interactive Stage Wait Indicator: Adds a continuous visual timer component and periodic status updates to the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "tip_delay_seconds": 15, "components": [{"type": "timer", "label": "Desktop Rendering in Progress", "style": "calm"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Adding a live preview waiting screen during onboarding maintains all required steps and jobs without violating any constraints.
Adding an informative account cloud backup hint on the sign-in screen is compliant with all onboarding rules.
Displaying rendering status and activity logs on the waiting screen preserves its function and complies with fair design rules.
Updating the home intro screen layout to an interactive shortcuts checklist is permitted within onboarding scope.
Reorganizing the adoption certificate into a split layout retains the certificate step and official adoption context.
Redesigning the home intro step layout into a stage preview with a launch button is allowed within onboarding.
Adding a path selection hint clarifying account synchronization complies with all onboarding rules.
Inserting a persona confirmation step into the onboarding flow while retaining all standard steps is permitted under rule 4.
Enabling a session notification switch and hint on the sign-in screen adheres to all base rules.
Adding a timer component during rendering on the waiting screen is permitted as it represents a real wait during pet generation.
